summary.text: Steve Malagari (listed by Ballotpedia as Steven Malagari) is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 53 who took office on December 1, 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a former Lansdale Borough Council member.

paragraphs.text: In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, his responses said he was born and raised in Lansdale, graduated from North Penn High School, served on Lansdale Borough Council, and worked as a Teamster and wholesale beverage seller.
Malagari succeeded Robert Godshall in District 53.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Appropriations, Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure, Liquor Control and Professional Licensure committees.
In the 2020 survey, he listed raising the minimum wage, expanding access to affordable health care and increasing public education funding as key messages.
Republican Yanni Lambros is his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
